name: Teeth Consistency
algorithm: Teeth Consistency — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes teeth rendering and consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Teeth감지&Segmentation**: When the mouth is open during speech or smiling, visible teeth are detected and segmented. Individual teeth boundaries, alignment, and arrangement are analyzed per frame.

2. **DentalAnatomy검증**: The method checks dental anatomy: (a) correct tooth count for visible region, (b) proper tooth shapes (incisors, canines, premolars with distinct morphology), (c) realistic tooth size and spacing, (d) gum line contour. AI generators often produce blurred, merged, or anatomically incorrect teeth — too many, too few, or with impossible shapes.

3. **Teeth텍스처&색상**: Real teeth show characteristic features: translucency at the incisal edge, varying color (slightly yellow body, whiter enamel surface), surface texture (microlines, stain patterns). The method evaluates teeth rendering quality. Generated teeth are often unrealistically white, uniformly colored, or lacking surface detail.

4. **시간적Teeth안정성**: Teeth structure is completely rigid — tooth positions, sizes, and arrangement cannot change between frames. The method tracks teeth geometry frame-to-frame. Changes in visible tooth arrangement (teeth appearing/disappearing, changing shape) indicate AI generation where teeth are rendered independently per frame.

5. **Teeth-입술Interaction**: During speech, lips interact with teeth in specific ways — upper teeth visible during /f/ and /v/ sounds, teeth edges visible during particular articulations. The method checks teeth-lip coordination. Deepfakes may show teeth visibility that doesn't correlate with the spoken phonemes.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through teeth consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
